blueprint.name: Kind Dev Cluster (Ubuntu)
blueprint.description: Provisions a kind Kubernetes cluster on Ubuntu for BNK development and testing. Ideal for local dev, CI pipelines, and quick demos.

outcomes: Kind Kubernetes cluster running on Ubuntu
Kubeconfig ready for BNK module deployment
Worker nodes configured for BNK data-plane

prerequisites.description: Ubuntu host with kind, kubectl, and Docker installed

modules.name: Kind Cluster
modules.description: Provisions a kind cluster with configurable worker nodes
